name: Top 200
epitaph: The rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy newsgroup's own year-end poll, counted every January and posted back to the group: two hundred wrestlers placed in order, with a written entry for the top twenty-five in most years. Eight editions survive, ranking 1996 through 2004, and the compiler of the first two cross-referenced them himself — the 1997 edition names a wrestler's 1996 place thirty-two times, twice getting the number wrong. What the poll is worth now is not the order it put people in but the census it took by accident: 1,610 placings, and in every year but the first, each one tagged with the federation the wrestler was writing for.

name: The Golden Headlock Award
notes: A newsgroup poll for the most popular federation of 1995, run by e-mail across the last week of December 1995 and named by its own runner, who reports 603 replies and says the full order ran to sixty federations. Thirty places were published; those are the thirty here. He was explicit that the question was popularity and not quality — “I will not say who is THE BEST FED! Instead it will be wich was the most popular of 95!”

The upper hundred spots (#200-#100) are not recovered.
